title: Aloe Vera in Face Cream: Benefits and How to Use It
ex: Aloe vera helps a face cream feel light, cooling and moisturising. Here is what it does, what it cannot do, and how it suits Indian weather.
rt: Aloe Vera in Face Cream: Benefits | Mirc Glow
rd: Aloe vera in face cream benefits explained: light hydration, a cooling feel and comfort with stronger actives. Plus its limits and fresh gel vs cream.
keyword: aloe vera in face cream benefits
quick: Aloe vera in a face cream helps skin feel moisturised and comfortable, gives the cream a lighter, cooling feel, and helps stronger ingredients like kojic acid feel gentler. It suits oily and combination skin well. It is not a sunscreen and does not change dark spots on its own.
facts: Aloe vera gel is mostly water with natural sugars.
The yellow sap under the leaf skin can irritate and is filtered out of cosmetic aloe.
Fresh aloe gel spoils within a day or two.
Most Mirc Glow creams contain aloe vera, niacinamide and kojic acid.
